name: Voltail at the campfire
notes: Voltail on the intro screen. It only shows once it is unlocked (unlocked >= 4) and sits on the half circle behind the fire: its seat depends on how many monsters are unlocked, all of them spread evenly from left to right in roster order, so with 4 unlocked it takes seat 4. It always looks at the fire (view per number unlocked: 4: left, 5: down-left, 6: down, 7: down, 8: down, 9: down). When it is shiny it shimmers through the rainbow, like everywhere else.
